senses.definition: n.pr. given to bronze serpent 2 K 18:4 prob. = bronze-god (so Thes, v. also BaudRel. i. 288; cf. נְחַשׁ נְחשֶׁת v 4 Nu 21:9(×2));—chief arg. ag. this are vocalization of 𝔊 Νεσθαλει, A 𝔊L Νε(ε)σθαν, and comparat. unimportance of material of wh. image was made; others think of נָחָשׁ serpent (Nö ZMG xiii (1888), 482 תן + נחשׁ, Kload loc. יתן + נחשׁ); LagBN 188, 205 thinks loan-wd.
